appDescription: A drive journal that saves spoken notes together with the current drive context.

function.name: ADD_DRIVE_NOTE
function.description: Save a spoken note to the drive journal.

note.description: The content of the note to save.

function.name: ADD_DRIVE_NOTES
function.description: Save a spoken note to the drive journal split into structured items.

original.description: The full spoken note exactly as the user said it.

items.description: Items split from the note; each item is an object with text, type (thought, todo, emotion or person), emotion (down, neutral or up) and keywords (array of strings).

function.name: SHOW_TODAY_CARD
function.description: Open the summary card of the current or most recent drive.
